# Bundled Markdown parser

`marked.mjs` is the unmodified ESM distribution of Marked 17.0.5, copied from the installed package. Its MIT license is retained in `MARKED-LICENSE.md`.

The build imports this local file, so no package installation or package-registry access is needed. It is used only while building and is not included in the public website.

Upstream: https://github.com/markedjs/marked
